what: UXD task benchmark: 15 standard daily drafting / modelling tasks. Each task has the method an expert uses in the incumbent, the llull target method (after this pack), and the llull method that works today (null when the task cannot be done to spec precision in the UI today). KLM times are computed by ../generate_refs.mjs from klm_operators.json into klm_predictions.json; measured times come from the Electron harness (system latency, pack 06) and from pilot users (human time, pack 01).
units: mm, document units; angles in degrees for the task sheet
posture: expert, error-free, two-handed (klm_operators.json R4); every task starts with nothing selected, no tool armed, the hand on the mouse, the view framed on the task region (2D tasks in the 2D view, 3D tasks in the 3D view)
incumbentNote: Incumbent sequences use documented mechanisms (sources.md R1-R30). Aliases other than L, C, E, P, Z (quoted in R2) are assumed defaults of the shipped acad.pgp and marked grade C until read on an installed copy; the alias length changes the prediction by 0.28 s per character.
